buildingInfo.command: The heart of the base: gives a build zone and a little income, and produces builders, trucks and harvesters. The roof laser hits enemies anywhere in the zone. Builders cannot raise it — an MCV deploys into it
buildingInfo.generator: Produces power for the zone. Without power, buildings work slower or stop
buildingInfo.matter: Earns credits on its own but eats power. Each next one in the zone asks for more power
buildingInfo.mine: Placed on a deposit, it digs ore into its own store; trucks take it to be refined. Starts a small zone of its own
buildingInfo.enricher: Enriches kharite ore into kharite — the most valuable resource
buildingInfo.blockPlant: Makes building blocks from metal: they are needed to construct buildings
buildingInfo.ammoBunker: Stores the zone's ammo; turrets are supplied from here
buildingInfo.spaceport: Sells resources from the zone's stores and buys missing ones for credits
buildingInfo.radar: Sees its surroundings and scouts distant spots in flashes; finds deposits
buildingInfo.barracks: Trains infantry: riflemen, rocketeers and flamethrowers
buildingInfo.factory: Builds ground vehicles and MCVs for new bases
buildingInfo.airfield: Builds aircraft: air trucks, drones, gunships and bombers
buildingInfo.techCenter: Runs research: it unlocks building levels, heavy vehicles, siege machines, the bomber and beam turrets
buildingInfo.wall: A cheap, sturdy barrier: blocks the way and shields from fire. Can be placed outside a zone
buildingInfo.gate: Plates that rise from the ground: lowered while no strangers are near, raised into a wall when an enemy approaches. Drag a line of any width. Can be placed outside the zone
buildingInfo.pipe: Links buildings into a network: pipes carry goods and power and extend the zone. Cheap and fragile, blocks passage. Can be placed outside a zone
buildingInfo.well: The entrance of an underground pipe: links with its pair in a straight line up to 10 tiles away. Units drive and build over the stretch. Can be placed outside a zone
buildingInfo.turret: A machine gun against infantry and light vehicles; hits aircraft too. Fires ammo from its own store
buildingInfo.rocketTurret: Rockets against vehicles and aircraft. Fires ammo from its own store
buildingInfo.cannonTurret: A splash cannon against ground vehicles; cannot hit aircraft. Fires ammo from its own store
buildingInfo.laserTurret: A laser that needs no ammo and runs on zone power. Especially strong against heavy vehicles; hits aircraft too
buildingInfo.arcTurret: An arc that needs no ammo and runs on zone power. Short range, but it jumps to neighbours: made for infantry crowds; four times weaker against aircraft

grid.wallTip: Drag a line with the mouse; a click places one

sectionTips.military: Barracks, factories, airfield and tech center
sectionTips.logistics: Pipes and wells: they link buildings into a network

stanceTips.aggressive: Go for any enemy in sight and chase it; units sent somewhere hit dangerous enemies on the way and move on
stanceTips.defensive: Hit whoever is in range; answer fire by chasing no farther than {leash} tiles, then return
stanceTips.hold: Never leave the spot: hit only those in range, even under fire
stanceTips.passive: Do not open or return fire: shoot only on an attack order

toolTips.foundation: Buildings on it go up twice as fast, and it allows building on sand. Explosions break it. Drag a rectangle with the mouse
toolTips.road: Ground units drive faster; over swamp it becomes a bridge at {bridge} per tile. Drag a line with the mouse
toolTips.pipe: Links buildings into a network: pipes carry goods and power and extend the zone. Blocks passage — run wells under a crossing. Needs no zone of its own. Drag a line with the mouse
toolTips.well: Wells are the ends of an underground pipe: a click places one (it links with a well in a straight line), a drag places a pair, up to {reach} tiles apart. Units drive and build above it; only the wells are vulnerable. Needs no zone of its own

grid.removeTip: Builders dismantle what is yours inside the frame: paving, pipes with wells and buildings fully inside it (pipes and buildings refund half the price); unfinished sites are cancelled with a refund. Drag a rectangle with the mouse
grid.cancelOrderTip: The last one in the queue; credits are refunded
grid.deployBlocked: Needs free rock or a 3×3 foundation under the vehicle
grid.patrolTip: P, then click the map — units walk between their spot and the point; Shift+click adds another patrol point
grid.routeTip: Click your buildings with a store in order; right button or Enter — done, Esc — cancel
grid.backToRequests: Trucks go back to zone requests
grid.filterTip: Which goods to carry on requests and routes
grid.serveTip: Click your buildings: trucks will carry only for their requests, picking goods up in any zone of yours. Right button or Enter — done, Esc — cancel
grid.allTip: Clear the filter: carry any goods
grid.reserveTip: How much the storage holds back from construction, production and turrets. Sales take the reserve too
grid.reserveAllTip: Give out nothing: the storage only fills up
grid.reserveNoneTip: Clear the reserve: give out everything
grid.seekAnyTip: The nearest known deposit; if none — scout
grid.seekTip: The nearest known deposit of this kind; if none — scout
grid.plantOffTip: The plant stops and no longer draws power; a started batch waits to be switched on, raw materials are hauled to the stores
grid.plantOnTip: The plant starts ordering raw materials from the zone and assembles up to the quota
grid.switchOffTip: Stops drawing zone power and working
grid.switchOnTip: Draws zone power again and resumes work
grid.sellingTip: A sale is in progress: open the order
grid.buyTip: Order resources from orbit at three times the selling price
grid.noRoom: Does not fit in the spaceport store
grid.buyPrice: {price} per unit; the ship arrives in 20 s
grid.sendTip: The ship leaves with what has been delivered so far
grid.giveTip: Money and cargo to an ally: the ship flies for 20 s
grid.giveBusyTip: The spaceport is busy: a ship is already under way

grid.giftTip: The selected units pass to the ally under their control, right where they stand
grid.giftWho: Whom to give the units to: pick an ally
grid.ferryWho: Whom to send the ship to: pick an ally
grid.ferryAmount: How much to put on the ship

grid.demolishTip: Builders dismantle the building; when they finish, half the price is refunded
grid.upgradeTip: Raise the level: {gain} ×{factor}. The price is paid at once, goods come from the building's network; builders do the work and the building keeps running
grid.upgradeNoMaterials: The building's network lacks the goods for the upgrade
grid.cancelUpgradeTip: Cancel the upgrade: its price is refunded in full
grid.needsResearch: Requires research at the tech center: {name}
grid.researchBusy: The tech center is busy with another topic
grid.researchNoParts: The tech center's network lacks components
grid.researchTip: The research takes {time}. The price is paid at once, components come from the tech center's network
grid.cancelResearchTip: Drop the research: its price is refunded in full

hud.friendTip: Base of {name}: {credits} cr. Click — the camera moves to it
hud.protectionTip: Newcomer protection: you cannot be attacked, and your units hold fire. An attack order ends it early
hud.clockStorm: Time of day; a storm is raging
hud.nothingSelected: Nothing selected. Left button — select, drag a box — several units, right button — order. Ctrl+digit — remember a group, digit — select it
hud.narrowTip: {name}: click — keep only them, Shift — remove from the selection
hud.overloaded: — overload, power plants are breaking down
hud.coreless: Earns nothing: the zone has no command center
hud.unlinked: Not connected to the network: lay a pipe — otherwise resources neither arrive nor leave
hud.starved: ⚡ Not enough power: the building works slower or stops
hud.switchedOff: Switched off: draws no power and does not work; switch it on in the grid on the right
hud.health: Health: {percent}. Repair costs {repair}: select builders and right-click the building
hud.armyHealth: Health: {percent}. Builders repair vehicles; infantry heals on its own
hud.armed: They fire at enemies in range on their own. Right-click an enemy to attack
hud.refines: Refines {ore} {oreName:lower} into {product} {productName:lower}, {intake} per second. Ore is brought by trucks from mines and by harvesters; free trucks deliver the output to the stores
hud.digs: Digging {icon} {name:lower} and hauling it to be refined.
hud.seeks: Seeking {icon} {name:lower}: among known deposits, or scouting if there are none.
hud.seeksAny: Seeking a deposit: among known ones, or scouting if there are none.
hud.harvestTip: Right-click a known deposit to dig there
hud.ammoEmpty: — empty, the turret is silent until resupplied
hud.ammoTip: . Once a quarter is spent, trucks resupply it from the zone's stores
hud.plantOff: The plant is off: switch it on in the grid on the right
hud.materialsWaiting: — waiting for delivery from the zone's stores
hud.routing: Setting a route: {stops} stops. Click your buildings with a store; right button or Enter — done, Esc — cancel
hud.serving: Choosing buildings: {count}. Click your buildings, click again to remove; right button or Enter — done, Esc — cancel
hud.haulsOre: Hauling ore from a mine to be refined
hud.serves: Serving assigned buildings: carries only for their requests, picking goods up in any zone of yours
hud.onRoute: Running a route: at each stop it unloads what is accepted there and loads for the next one
hud.free: Free: takes zone requests on its own. Right-click a mine to haul only from it
hud.sellHint: Selling from the zone's stores: pick a resource, then the amount
hud.dealBuy: — cost {total}, room for {room} more in the hold
hud.nothingToSell: Nothing to sell: the zone's stores are empty
hud.buyHint: . Buying from orbit costs three times the selling price; trucks deliver the goods to the stores
hud.waitsToDemolish: Waiting for a builder: select one and right-click the building
hud.waitsToUpgrade: The upgrade awaits a builder: select one and right-click the building
hud.researchIdle: Pick a research topic: what is unlocked stays forever
hud.blocked: The site is blocked by units
hud.rallySet: Finished units go to the flag; right-click the map to move it
hud.rallyTip: Right-click the map to set a rally point
hud.patrolPick: Click — patrol to the point; Shift+click — another patrol point; right button or Esc — cancel
hud.pavingRemove: Drag with the left button over what to remove
hud.paving: Drag with the left button: {tiles} tiles, {cost} credits
hud.builderTip: Constructs buildings and repairs yours: right-click a site or a damaged one. Buildings are in the grid on the right
hud.placingTip: Left button — place, again and again; right button or Esc — finish

researchInfo.levels2: Unlocks building level two: mines, refineries, stores, the spaceport and power plants
researchInfo.armor: Unlocks the tank and the tesla at the factory
researchInfo.siege: Unlocks artillery and the carrier at the factory
researchInfo.bombing: Unlocks the bomber at the airfield
researchInfo.beams: Unlocks the laser and arc turrets

help.list: who is in the game now
help.me: write about yourself in the third person
help.ally: offer an alliance to a leader or a loner, or accept theirs: you don't attack each other and share scouting
help.unally: with a name — kick an ally (leader), withdraw your offer or decline theirs; without a name — leave the alliance (a leader disbands it)
help.give: transfer credits to an ally: the money arrives at once
help.editor: live world editor: the whole map without fog, edits are seen by everyone at once; once more — leave
help.hide: vanish for players: not in the list, joining and leaving are not announced; once more — reappear
help.say: write to everyone on behalf of the server
help.kick: disconnect a player; their base stays
help.credits: set a player's credits; +N and -N add and subtract
help.players: all players of the world: number, online or not, credits, units and buildings
help.spawn: place units at a player's base (for yourself — without a nickname)
help.killunits: remove all units of a player or of everyone (all); buildings stay
help.heal: fully repair a player's vehicles and buildings
help.reset: wipe everything a player has and give them a new starting kit
help.reveal: reveal the whole map to a player
help.stop: save the world and stop the server

editor.title: Editor
editor.nobodyTip: Nobody's: buildings and units without an owner
editor.cameraTip: Where the player's camera is when the game starts: a frame on the map; drag an edge to move it, a corner to zoom
editor.paintNote: A mountain rises as a single peak in the middle of the brush, as large as the brush (at most {tiles} tiles). Neighbouring mountains join into a ridge; a mountain touched by other ground is erased whole. Dunes lie only on sand.
editor.paintNoteLocal: Map edits are seen by all players at once.
editor.paintNoteRemote: Players see an edit once it comes into their view.
editor.depositNote: A click puts a deposit where the ghost is. Select, move and change them in “Select”.
editor.selectNote: Click — select, box — units, buildings and deposits together, Shift — add or remove. The selection is dragged as one. Right-click or Delete — erase.
editor.mouseOrderTip: The next click on the map is an order, like the right button in the game; with Shift it is queued
editor.exitConfirm: Leave without saving? The edits will be lost.

game.surrenderConfirm: Surrender? All your units and buildings will blow up.
game.defeatLocal: No buildings and no MCV are left.
game.defeatServer: No buildings and no MCV are left. You can start over in a new place of this world.
